findings.title: OS_IsValidIP dotted-quad netmask uses network address as mask, bypassing remoted allowed-ips and related ACL checks
findings.description: In the full-netmask branch of OS_IsValidIP (a.b.c.d/w.x.y.z), after splitting on '/', nmask is assigned with inet_addr(ip_address) instead of inet_addr(tmp_str). Only mask 255.255.255.255 is special-cased correctly. CIDR /N forms are fine. Configured allowed-ips such as 10.0.0.0/255.255.255.0 therefore store netmask=10.0.0.0, so OS_IPFound accepts large unrelated client ranges. Same parser feeds denied-ips, agent IP binding (OS_IsAllowedDynamicID), and AR white_list.
findings.impact: When syslog remoted uses dotted-quad allowed-ips, unauthenticated peers outside the intended subnet can inject syslog events into analysisd. Agent IP restrictions written with dotted masks can also be bypassed by a key holder from unexpected addresses.
findings.attack_path:
1. Operator enables remoted syslog with allowed-ips using dotted mask (supported by ip_address_regex).
2. OS_IsValidIP stores wrong netmask.
3. Attacker sends/spoofs syslog from an IP that matches the broken mask check but not the intended /24.
4. OS_IPNotAllowed returns allow; event enters DEFAULTQUEUE as SYSLOG_MQ.
findings.remediation: Set nmask from inet_addr(tmp_str). Add regression tests for dotted masks vs adjacent and distant IPs.

findings.title: authd terminates on enrollment pool exhaustion instead of rejecting excess clients
findings.description: When active_processes >= POOL_SIZE (512), the accept loop breaks out of while(1) and clean_exit shuts down the daemon. Held TCP connections keep children in SSL_accept/SSL_read while the parent still counts them toward the pool.
findings.impact: Unauthenticated network peers can permanently stop ossec-authd until an external process restarts it, denying agent enrollment.
findings.attack_path:
1. Reach TCP 1515.
2. Open and hold 512 connections so children block in SSL handshake/read.
3. Trigger one more accept; parent hits pool check and break.
4. clean_exit ends authd.
findings.remediation: On pool exhaustion close the new client socket and continue the listen loop; do not break/exit.
